STATEMENT OF WORK (SYNTHETIC — CORE-200 TEST FIXTURE)
Solicitation No.: SYN-B-0002
Title: Shipboard Fire-Control System Preventive Maintenance

1. SCOPE
The Contractor shall perform scheduled preventive maintenance,
calibration, and corrective maintenance on shipboard fire-control
radar and weapons-direction system components aboard notional surface
combatants during in-port availabilities.

2. REQUIREMENTS
2.1 The Contractor shall perform preventive maintenance checks and
    services (PMCS) on fire-control system line-replaceable units per
    the applicable technical manual maintenance index page (MIP).
2.2 The Contractor shall calibrate fire-control radar alignment per
    the ship's combat systems maintenance plan.
2.3 The Contractor shall document all fire-control maintenance actions
    in the ship's 3-M (Maintenance and Material Management) system.

3. PLACE OF PERFORMANCE
Pierside, notional Naval Station, aboard assigned surface combatants.
